neighbours.label: ' products' / ' goods' / ' actions' as a later item of a comma list ('names, products, and logos')
fire: Trademarks cover a company's names, products, and packaging.
The survey asked about people's beliefs, actions, and habits.
Tariffs raise the price of imported materials, goods, and machinery.
The agency reviews our plans, products, and advertising each year.
Ethics is concerned with our motives, actions, and their effects.
The port handles passengers, goods, and mail from the islands.
The site lets customers compare prices, products, and delivery times.
The firm offers consulting, products, or services to small businesses.
quiet: Trademarks cover a company's names, logos, and packaging.
The survey asked about people's beliefs, fears, and habits.
Tariffs raise the price of imported materials, steel, and machinery.
The agency reviews our plans, budgets, and advertising each year.
Ethics is concerned with our motives, feelings, and their effects.
The port handles passengers, cars, and mail from the islands.
The site lets customers compare prices, reviews, and delivery times.
The products came late, so the manager phoned the supplier.

notes: Card: ' products' x12, ' goods' x4, ' actions' x3, ' services' x2, mostly inside lists. Probes: 'logos, products, and' 0.55, 'words, actions, and' 0.45, 'contracts, goods, and' 0.41, 'products or services' 0.25; 'range of products' 0.18, 'The products arrived' 0.07, same lists without the words 0.08.
